description: Fingerprints of the tested Windows x86 PD2/D2GL files and plugin, with activation and loader settings.
validation: All three Win32 Release suites pass with local artwork, local tables and private archive table snapshots. The same table loader was verified in-game with archive-only table reads and ordinary direct overrides; the user confirmed both worked. The release retains beta.1 rendering/defaults. Broader map performance and long-session compatibility remain under test.
gameTables: Automatically read from active installed game archives or direct overrides via native Storm; the development fixture hashes are informational, not files to download. Missing or malformed tables retain native/per-area fallback.
